title: Calibrated Mars 2020 SuperCam VISIR Spectra: Berry Hollow & Thornton Gap
description: Calibrated passive VISIR reflectance spectra (roughly 1.31–2.59 µm) for Berry Hollow (sol 515, Wildcat Ridge abrasion patch) and Thornton Gap (sol 493, Skinner Ridge abrasion patch). Channels are sorted by ascending wavelength and filtered by quality_flag == 0.
citation: Wiens, R. C., and Maurice, S. A. (2021). Mars 2020 SuperCam Bundle, version 9.0. NASA Planetary Data System. https://doi.org/10.17189/1522646
display_credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/LANL/CNES/CNRS, Mars 2020 SuperCam team, NASA PDS Geosciences Node
unit_confirmation_note: The SIS (section 5.1.5) defines I_F as reflectance (radiance divided by a modelled solar spectrum for the observation geometry and time) and I_F_Atm as that reflectance corrected for atmospheric absorption (mainly CO2). Both are dimensionless reflectance factor / radiance factor (I/F). The PDS4 label field carries unit 'W/m2/sr/µm', which is an archive label clerical artifact; the data values are dimensionless reflectance factor.
